proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q x y hab
  have hN : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
    · have hb₀ : b ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => hab ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hl, s, rfl, rfl⟩
    have hs : s * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) = -(a * p + b * q + c) := by linear_combination hl
    have hs' : s = -(a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hN]; exact hs
    rw [hs']
    constructor <;> ring
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · field_simp; ring
    · exact ⟨-(a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), by ring, by ring⟩
